coordinates.name: state_or_carrier
coordinates.description: Source-grounded state-like carrier or variable participating in the claim; does not by itself imply representation, persistence, ownership, or mentality.

coordinates.name: partition_or_subsystem
coordinates.description: Grounded grouping, candidate subsystem partition, equivalence class, or comparison partition; may be a family of candidate partitions.

coordinates.name: transition_coupling_or_dependency
coordinates.description: Typed transition, change, dependency, causal/counterfactual coupling, or directional relation preserved as explicit topology.

coordinates.name: observation_or_access
coordinates.description: Source-grounded observation, measurement, readout, sensing/access channel, or information-availability structure.

coordinates.name: temporal_structure
coordinates.description: Ordering, horizon, history window, recurrence, persistence, phase, or other time-indexed constraint required by the normalized claim.

coordinates.name: resource_or_capacity_constraint
coordinates.description: Declared resource, budget, capacity, cost, bottleneck, or boundedness constraint.

coordinates.name: evaluation_or_relevance_criterion
coordinates.description: Criterion, loss, utility, viability condition, success relation, relevance surface, threshold, or criterion family with explicit provenance.

coordinates.name: probe_intervention_or_transformation
coordinates.description: Typed probe, manipulation, intervention, test, perturbation, or transformation family, optionally with declared internal structure.
